caption: A sunny urban park plaza features a tall, conical blue spruce with silvery-blue needles standing at the center of a sandy planting bed, ringed by low rounded green hedges, a tuft of fine ornamental grass, and a small yellow-brown shrub. To the left, a leafy green deciduous tree rises beside a grey stone-paved walkway where a small reddish-brown sign sits on a stone base, while to the right more clipped hedges, a wooden bench, and trees with rust-colored autumn leaves line the path. In the background, tall beige and white residential apartment towers rise above the treeline under a bright blue sky streaked with thin white clouds. The scene is lit by strong midday sunlight that casts crisp shadows across the grey paving stones and the manicured greenery.
